description: Source code for managing custom emojis in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, deletion, image processing, and URL generation.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for emoji management.

methods.name: CreateEmoji
methods.description: Creates a new custom emoji after validation and image upload.

methods.name: GetEmojiList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of emojis.

methods.name: uploadEmojiImage
methods.description: Uploads and processes the emoji image, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteEmoji
methods.description: Deletes an emoji and associated images and reactions.

methods.name: GetEmoji
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji by its ID.

methods.name: GetEmojiByName
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji by its name.

methods.name: GetMultipleEmojiByName
methods.description: Retrieves multiple emojis by their names.

methods.name: GetEmojiImage
methods.description: Fetches the image bytes and type for an emoji.

methods.name: SearchEmoji
methods.description: Searches emojis by name with optional prefix matching.

methods.name: GetEmojiStaticURL
methods.description: Returns URL for static emoji image, system or custom.
